title.narrative: Second Rwanda Urban Development Project (RUDP II) 2023-2026

description.narrative:
The overall development objective of RUDP II is to improve access to basic services, enhance resilience and strengthen integrated urban planning and management. Denmark is co-funding the project's sub-component 1b. The objective for sub-component 1b is wetland rehabilitation and flood risk reduction.
The sub-component 1b will support the design, implementation and monitoring of nature-based solutions to reduce flood risks, enhance biodiversity, and strengthen resilience in the City of Kigali, Rwanda. This allows for subsequent scalability within a Secondary Cities programme, by adding a further wetlands component, once scoping and feasibility studies are completed.
The project is anticipating the following results: 1) People benefitting from flood risk reduction and wetland rehabilitation interventions in Kigali (220,500 persons), 2) Rehabilitation of wetlands (491 Ha), 3) Development of long-term management strategy and business plan for management and maintenance of rehabilitated wetlands, and 4) Development and operationalization of greenhouse gas accounting and reporting framework
